desc.title: Description
desc.description: More details about when the key should be used.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Any additional details associated with the key.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where the information was sourced from and where it can be reviewed for updates in the future.

values.title: Values
values.description:
Possible values associated with the key, which are themselves either keys or codes
depending on the context.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description:
Regular expression used to validate the value instead of a fixed value from the
code or key definitions.

map.title: Code Map
map.description:
Maps local keys to specific codes, useful for converting the described key into a
local code.

cbc.Definition.description: Definition defines properties of a key, code, or other value that has a specific meaning or utility.
